name: Kagaku to Mahou no Kasou Sekai Vol. 7
original_name: 科学と魔法の仮想世界Vol.7
source:
Several days after completing his quest with Sanae, Akira meets Kyouka and Erina while wandering in the main city of Fantasy World. Erina is worried that someone in Ragondo has been watching her and asks Akira to go there with her.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE142639.html]DLsite English[/url]]
